019package org.apache.bcel.generic;
020
021/**
022 * Equality of instructions isn't clearly to be defined. You might wish, for example, to compare whether instructions
023 * have the same meaning. E.g., whether two INVOKEVIRTUALs describe the same call.
024 * <p>
025 * The DEFAULT comparator however, considers two instructions to be equal if they have same opcode and point to the same
026 * indexes (if any) in the constant pool or the same local variable index. Branch instructions must have the same
027 * target.
028 * </p>
029 *
030 * @see Instruction
031 */
032public interface InstructionComparator {
033
034    InstructionComparator DEFAULT = (i1, i2) -> {
035        if (i1.getOpcode() == i2.getOpcode()) {
036            if (i1 instanceof BranchInstruction) {
037                // BIs are never equal to make targeters work correctly (BCEL-195)
038                return false;
039//                } else if (i1 == i2) { TODO consider adding this shortcut
040//                    return true; // this must be AFTER the BI test
041            }
042            if (i1 instanceof ConstantPushInstruction) {
043                return ((ConstantPushInstruction) i1).getValue().equals(((ConstantPushInstruction) i2).getValue());
044            }
045            if (i1 instanceof IndexedInstruction) {
046                return ((IndexedInstruction) i1).getIndex() == ((IndexedInstruction) i2).getIndex();
047            }
048            if (i1 instanceof NEWARRAY) {
049                return ((NEWARRAY) i1).getTypecode() == ((NEWARRAY) i2).getTypecode();
050            }
051            return true;
052        }
053        return false;
054    };
055
056    boolean equals(Instruction i1, Instruction i2);
057}
